newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends mixed, August pressured down.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends mixed, August pressured down.

text.p: White sugar futures ended mostly firmer on Tuesday but persistent broker selling ensured that the spot August contract remained weak and below support at $325, traders said.

Light support from trade covering of short August positions was seen earlier in the session but was not enough to counter outright and spread sales by throughout the day by a leading French brokerage, they said.
But scale buying in August/October was also noted as players covered short August positions amid a perception of seasonal tightness into the European summer.
August closed down $1.30 at $324.80 and October up 20 cents at $316.80. Volume was dominated by the August trading and amounted to a solid 2,606 lots.
